title: Named-root capacity follow-ups: own-release 404 ordering, route/bridge/resume/canonical-own tests, typed refusal reason field
outcome: The named-root own release and capacity paths are covered end to end and answer precisely: an unknown caller session gets 404 before any lookup; the HTTP own route and the termal_release_named_root bridge handler, an own-release resume, an own release of a canonically associated root, the refused-claim end-to-end path and the Engram error-reason folding all have tests; and the refusal reason is a typed field rather than message text.
acceptance: POST /api/sessions/{id}/engram-named-root-release answers 404 for an unknown session before looking up any root, with a test

Tests cover: the own HTTP route and the bridge tool's argument checks and forwarding as the serving session; resuming an unconfirmed own release; an own release of a canonically associated root (route canonical, requested_by the session); an authority read refused with claim_not_current_for_run recording the claim and the next pass disposing of the root; EngramControlErrorWire folding `reason`
EngramControlErrorBody (or the read error) carries `reason` as a typed field and the claim-not-current check matches it exactly, keeping the message-text fallback for older Engram builds
